entities.summary: Raymond Tyler Downey is a Canadian former boxer who won a light middleweight bronze medal at the 1988 Summer Olympics. In 1990, he won silver at the 1990 Commonwealth Games. He is a member of Nova Scotia's "Boxing Downeys" family of fighters. His father was boxer David Downey.
